# gpupaas_mks_cluster_profile (Data Source)

A cluster profile (Kubernetes SKU): the Kubernetes versions, CNIs, SKUs, images and datacenters a `gpupaas_mks_cluster` created from it may use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_mks_cluster_profile" "k8s" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "mks-oneclick-1"
}

output "supported_versions" {
  value = data.gpupaas_mks_cluster_profile.k8s.supported_kubernetes_versions
}

output "control_plane_skus" {
  value = data.gpupaas_mks_cluster_profile.k8s.control_plane.sku_names
}

output "datacenters" {
  value = data.gpupaas_mks_cluster_profile.k8s.datacenters
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project` (String) Project that holds the profile, usually `system-catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `control_plane` (Attributes) What the profile allows for control-plane nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_plane))
- `datacenters` (List of String)
- `default_blueprint` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_blueprint))
- `default_cni` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_cni))
- `default_kubernetes_version` (String)
- `default_pod_subnet` (String)
- `default_service_subnet` (String)
- `default_ssh_key` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `supported_cnis` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--supported_cnis))
- `supported_kubernetes_versions` (List of String)
- `version` (String)
- `workers` (Attributes) What the profile allows for worker pools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workers))
